title: Path kernel: a stay link along the air crosses the arc lead of the first entry (Outside, after #4254)

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:max
labels.description: New algorithms, formats or open design (issue-worker-max)

body:
Found while the branch of PR #4279 (#4269, the converter from a kernel plan to a toolpath) took the merge of `side/path-kernel` after PR #4275 (#4254, the approach from the air).

What happens: the K4 pin converts the whole kernel plan with the real converter (`camcraft_motion::kernel_emit`). On Outside, the converted path has feed crossings:
- disc Outside: 3 crossings, all at (-38.398, -28.993)
- dog bone Outside: 1 crossing at (4.587, -28.866)
- Inside: 0

Each crossing is in the air, one tool radius outside the stock. The first entry of the plan is an air entry with an arc lead (moves 2 to 11). Later stay-down links of #4254 run along the air line (y -29) to the door of an approach, and they cross that lead. Example on the disc: moves 189, 1664 and 1882 go from (-40, -29) along y -29.

Cause: the link stage proves a link against the made cuts, the links and the planned cuts (`crates/pathkernel/src/link/proof.rs`, `Proof::crossing`). It does not read the moves of the entry stage (the arc lead and the helix of an entry). Before #4254 these links lifted, so no route went along the air there. The kernel's own test pen emits no leads, so the kernel laws read 0.

Safety: the verifier pin `k6a_plan_emit` finds no `RapidInStock`, no `RapidInPart`, no `PlungeIntoStock` and no `Gouge` on these paths. The verifier reports the crossings as `Crossing` warnings only. No material is in the air, so this is a quality law, not a gouge.

Expected: no feed of a link crosses the lead of an entry. The link proof reads the entry leads that are already planned (or the entry stage plans its lead clear of the link routes).

Evidence: `crates/motion/tests/kernel_laws/k4_order_link.rs`, the table `CROSSINGS` pins the counts as measured on the merged branch.

Done means: the link stage (or the entry stage) gives no crossing of a link and an entry lead on the disc and the dog bone, Outside; the K4 table `CROSSINGS` is 0 on each case; a kernel law pins it.
